title: Jury Duty
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Jim returns from jury duty and shares his experience with the office, which leads to Dwight accusing him of lying to avoid work. The office navigates tensions around Jim's absence, while also celebrating Angela's newborn baby Philip, whose paternity becomes a point of contention with Dwight. Jim attempts to reconcile with his coworkers through small gestures, but faces mixed reactions. Meanwhile, Dwight deals with his own personal conflicts and a bizarre recurring nightmare, and the office meets Officer Foley, whose authenticity is questioned.
